title: Add alcanzai ingest-job subcommand to Rust binary
description:
Extend alcanzai-core/src/bin/alcanzai.rs with an ingest-job subcommand.

Usage: alcanzai ingest-job --library <path> --job-dir <path>

Reads <job-dir>/raw_document.json → calls SqliteLibrary.ingest() → writes:
- <job-dir>/result.json: { 'status': 'ok', 'ko_id': '<uuid>' } or { 'status': 'error', 'message': '...' }
- <job-dir>/status.json: { 'phase': 'complete', 'completed_at': '<iso8601>' } or { 'phase': 'failed', ... }

Writes are atomic (write to .tmp, rename) per ADR-004.

ExactMatch case: writes result.json with status='exact_match', ko_id='<existing-uuid>'. Not an error — the job succeeded (idempotent ingest).

Acceptance:
- cargo test: unit test with a temp job dir containing fixture 01_academic_pdf_clean.json ingests and writes correct result.json.
- Re-running ingest-job with same job dir (or a new job dir with identical content_hash): result.json shows exact_match, Library has one KO not two.
- cargo clippy -- -D warnings passes; cargo fmt passes.
